user_query: I'm working on an adult-themed website and I need a collection of random adult pictures to use as background images. Can you provide me with pictures from different categories? It would be great to have a diverse range of visuals.

TaskList.description: Research and identify various adult image categories for diverse visuals.
Find a suitable API that provides access to adult-themed images in the identified categories.
Query the selected API to retrieve a collection of random adult pictures from different categories.
Download and save the retrieved images for use on the website.
